raw_block.rationale: Encodes two independently grounded section 151 patterns: the inclusive 2018–2025 special-zero window and the direct dependent-exemption entitlement in subsection (c), preserving the native boolean and Entailment/Contradiction outputs.

inputs.name: tax_year
inputs.question: What tax year is stated in the current facts?

skill.intent: Determine whether section 151(d)(5)'s special zero-exemption rule applies to the current tax year.

outputs.description: Whether the special zero-exemption period covers the current tax year.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: first_zero_year

origin.quote: In the case of a taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026, the term "exemption amount" means zero.

premises.question: What is the first taxable-year start year covered by the current special zero-exemption rule?

premises.name: last_zero_year

origin.quote: In the case of a taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026, the term "exemption amount" means zero.

premises.question: What is the last taxable-year start year covered by the current special zero-exemption rule?

fields.question: What is the first covered tax year?

fields.name: last_zero_year
fields.question: What is the last covered tax year?

reads.question: From the current section 151(d)(5), jointly convert the stated after/before dates into the first and last covered taxable-year start years.
reads.source_locator: Current source_text, section 151(d)(5), Special rules for taxable years.

origin.quote: In the case of a taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026, the term "exemption amount" means zero.

source_obligations.statement: Translate a year beginning after December 31, 2017 and before January 1, 2026 into the inclusive tax-year range 2018 through 2025.

origin.quote: Does the special zero-exemption rule in section 151(d)(5) apply in this tax year? Do not ask whether the final exemption could be zero for another reason.

source_obligations.statement: Return only whether subsection (d)(5)'s special rule applies, without considering other reasons the final exemption amount might be zero.

source_provenance.quote: (5) Special rules for taxable years 2018 through 2025

inputs.name: individual_is_taxpayer_dependent
inputs.question: Do the current facts establish that the individual is the taxpayer's dependent under section 152 for the relevant tax year?

inputs.name: proposition_says_claimable
inputs.question: Does the current proposition assert that the taxpayer can claim the dependent exemption under section 151(c)?

skill.intent: Classify a proposition that a taxpayer may claim a section 151(c) exemption for an individual established as the taxpayer's dependent.

premises.name: dependent_exemption_authorized

origin.quote: An exemption of the exemption amount for each individual who is a dependent (as defined in section 152) of the taxpayer for the taxable year.

premises.question: Does the current section authorize an exemption of the exemption amount for each individual who is the taxpayer's dependent for the taxable year?

fields.name: dependent_exemption_authorized
fields.question: Does subsection (c) authorize the described dependent exemption?

reads.question: From the current section 151(c), determine whether it authorizes a taxpayer exemption for each individual who is the taxpayer's section 152 dependent for that taxable year.
reads.source_locator: Current source_text, section 151(c), Additional exemption for dependents.

origin.quote: Bob counts as Alice's dependent under section 152(c)(1) for 2015.

source_obligations.statement: When the current facts establish section 152 dependent status, apply section 151(c)'s authorization for that dependent.

origin.quote: Alice can claim an exemption with Bob the dependent for 2015 under section 151(c).

source_obligations.statement: Return Entailment when the proposition matches the resulting claimability determination and Contradiction when it asserts the opposite.

source_provenance.quote:
(c) Additional exemption for dependents

An exemption of the exemption amount for each individual who is a dependent (as defined in section 152) of the taxpayer for the taxable year.
